caption:
Your calendar has empty slots that used to be booked jobs.

Appointments booked more than two weeks out no-show up to 33% of the time. Same-day bookings rarely miss.

The fix has three parts.

Text a reminder at 7 days out, then again at 24 hours. One text isn't enough for a booking made weeks ago.

Make it two-way. Let clients reply CONFIRM, CANCEL, or RESCHEDULE. A reply catches a cancellation early enough to refill the slot.

The second a slot opens, text your waitlist: "Earlier appointment open Thursday 2pm. Reply YES to claim it." First reply wins it.

See it running on your own calendar. 14 days free.

rationale: Quick-tutorial, to-camera reels win completion and saves right now. This script delivers a three-part no-show recovery system, a reminder cadence, two-way confirmation, and waitlist backfill, that stands apart from previous reminder, booking, and dispatch content.
